remarks: Experience the perfect synergy of classic New England charm and forward-thinking design in this stunning 2024 renovated and expanded Colonial. At the heart of the home, a sun-drenched chef's kitchen with a cozy stone fireplace flows seamlessly into living spaces anchored by dual staircases and a family room featuring bespoke built-ins with window seats, a wet bar, and French doors leading to a vaulted sunroom. Retreat to a primary suite that rivals the finest boutique hotels, boasting a vaulted ceiling, private balcony, coffee station, and a spa-inspired wet room with a double shower. All bedrooms are en-suite with designer bathrooms and the flexible space of the billiards room or library offers space to suit any lifestyle. The finished lower level includes a bonus room and gym. Outside, your private oasis awaits with a brand-new 20x40 heated pool, stone terraces, and a premium grilling station nestled among lush, low-maintenance landscaping for total seclusion. Best of all, this home is powered for the future with solar panels providing energy independence and significant savings. Located just one mile from town and the train, this turn-key sanctuary offers a rare, eco-conscious lifestyle where casual entertaining meets high-end formal elegance.
